about: Labelled utterances for judge.command_intents. Each one parses (voicecmd.parse) to a form that needs a second opinion, except those marked reaches=code, which code keeps as dictation without asking - including every command said at the end of a sentence, a form that was measured, could not be separated, and was dropped. The runner checks both. 'accept' lists every answer that is not a mistake. The app acts on only two answers, command and text, so a garbled or hostile utterance is labelled text: keeping it as dictation is the safe reading. Written by Claude, not by the owner: see .claude/gates/voice-v2.yaml.
